title: Unified gateway, capabilities and ED209 security boundary
summary: A single startable unified XTP gateway should cover UDP, native IP protocol 36 and Ethernet L2 and route authenticated named-service FIRST to locally registered application listeners. Remote session authentication is not qualified in gateway candidate1.
invariants: No permanent production bypass switch for unauthenticated remote gateway sessions
Do not represent local UID Unix socket registration as remote node authentication
Only allow operational classes from Service Descriptor registration, never incoming FIRST caller assertion
Native raw XTP uses CAP_NET_RAW when required; CAP_NET_ADMIN only if changing network configuration
Keep emergency out-of-band rollback access operational before touching ED209 bootstraps
Use /home/hc3/alchemy-autobuild/sshnode.sh <node> ... as existing ED209 operational convention rather than assume raw ssh/scp
procedure: Bind remote cryptographic principal to protected established XTP KEY/session
Authorise service endpoint and operation before dispatch
Exercise full lifetime: handshake, repeated DATA, replay, reorder, live state transitions and session close
Qualify UDP localhost first, raw36 ED209 pair second, L2 separately where actual topology permits

qualification_boundaries.field: raw36/L2 endpoint and long-lived stream not qualified
